entries.speaker: Changing Personas
entries.en: [fName]'s potential allows him to hold [n]multiple Personas. As such, you can [clr 2]freely[clr 27] [n][clr 2]change which Persona[clr 27] you have summoned.

entries.speaker: Changing Personas
entries.en: When you change Personas, your stats, attribute[n]affinities, and available skills will change to match[n]the Persona you select.

entries.speaker: Changing Personas
entries.en: While in the [clr 2]Persona[clr 27] menu, press [clr 2][f 1 10 47] or [f 1 10 48][clr 27][n]to change Personas. Outside battle, press [f 1 10 25],[n]then select [clr 2]Persona[clr 27] to change.

entries.speaker: Changing Personas
entries.en: You may normally change Personas whenever[n]you'd like, but during battle you can only change[n]Personas [clr 2]once per turn[clr 27].
